title: A Poster That People Can Read
transcript:
Could you look at this poster for our student book exchange? I like the photograph of the shelves, but people who saw the draft said they could not tell what the event was.
The photograph takes up most of the space. Your title is hidden over the darkest part of it, and the important details are scattered around the edges.
I wanted it to look less like a classroom notice. Would changing the title to yellow make it easier to see? 
A brighter colour might help, but I would first make the title larger and place it on a plain background. People walking past will give it only a few seconds.
What about the long paragraph explaining how the exchange works? We set a limit and require good condition.
Keep the basic action on the poster: bring a book and choose another. Put the detailed rules on the event page and include a code people can scan.
Some visitors may not want to use their phones. Could we also put a printed copy of the rules at the library desk?
Yes, and mention that on the poster. Check the date too. It says Friday the eighteenth, but our booking confirmation is for Saturday.
I'm glad you noticed. I'll correct that before printing. Should I order the whole batch once I've made these changes?
Print one at its actual size first. Put it on the noticeboard and stand a few steps away. That is more useful than checking your laptop screen.

questions.prompt: What problem did people report with the draft poster?
options: They could not identify what event it advertised.
They thought the exchange was too expensive.
They could not find the photographer's name.
They believed the library had closed permanently.
questions.answer: They could not identify what event it advertised.
questions.explanation: 看过草稿的人表示看不出海报宣传的具体活动。

questions.prompt: What change is recommended for the title?
options: Replace it with a longer paragraph.
Make it larger and put it on a plain background.
Move it to the edge of the photograph.
Remove it and use only a scan code.
questions.answer: Make it larger and put it on a plain background.
questions.explanation: 建议先放大标题并置于纯色背景上，而不是只调整颜色。

questions.prompt: How will detailed rules be available to people without using phones?
options: Through a recorded announcement at the entrance.
Through messages sent only to club members.
On a printed sheet at the library desk.
On the back of every exchanged book.
questions.answer: On a printed sheet at the library desk.
questions.explanation: 两人决定在图书馆服务台放纸质规则，照顾不想用手机的访客。

questions.prompt: What should the student do before ordering all the posters?
options: Wait until the book exchange has finished.
Ask everyone to bring a laptop.
Move the event to the Friday shown in the draft.
Test one full size print on the noticeboard.
questions.answer: Test one full size print on the noticeboard.
questions.explanation: 应先印一张实际尺寸的样张，贴上布告板并从几步外检查可读性。
